name: localhost-proxy
description: Opens the crew’s localhost previews and links through Wheelhouse itself, so they work when Wheelhouse runs in Docker, a cloud workspace or another computer.

ports.title: More ports to allow
ports.description: Ports on Wheelhouse’s computer to open even when nobody has reported them (for example 3000, 8080). Wheelhouse’s own port is never opened.

publicAddress.title: Public address of a port
publicAddress.description: Where your browser opens a port when Wheelhouse runs on a hosted or remote machine, with {port} for the port: such as https://{port}--abc123.example.dev or http://my-vm.example.dev:{port}. Codespaces and Gitpod are found without it. The proxy’s pages link there; empty for none.
